'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[2024 Hama offensive]]
****The [[Syrian Army]] says that it has withdrawn from the city of [[Hama]] in order to "protect the lives of civilians" after rebel forces enter the city. Rebel forces later begin releasing hundreds of prisoners from Hama's central prison. [https://www.msn.com/en-gb/news/world/syrian-army-pulls-out-of-hama-after-insurgents-break-through-defences/ar-AA1vkcu6 (MSN)] [https://www.ynetnews.com/article/byykofkvyl (Ynet)]
****A helicopter is shot down after taking off from [[Hama Air Base]] as [[Syrian Armed Forces|pro-government forces]] evacuate the airbase. Another helicopter that took off from the air base makes an emergency landing after being hit. The airbase is later fully captured by the rebels. [https://www.aljazeera.net/news/2024/12/5/%D8%B9%D8%A7%D8%AC%D9%84-%D8%B3%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%A7-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AC%D9%8A%D8%B4-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B3%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D9%8A%D8%B9%D9%8A%D8%AF-%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AA%D8%B4%D8%A7%D8%B1%D9%87 (Al Jazeera)] [https://www.yenisafak.com/en/world/anti-regime-armed-groups-in-syria-capture-hama-city-3695346 (YeniSafak)]
****Rebel forces enter the city of [[Salamiyah]] in [[Hama Governorate]] after reportedly facing no resistance. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%87%d9%8a%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d9%83%d8%a8%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d9%84%d9%82%d9%88%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%86%d8%b8%d8%a7%d9%85-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%87%d9%80-%d9%80%d9%8a%d9%80-%d9%80%d8%a6%d8%a9/739376/ (SOHR)]
****Rebels capture the town of [[Qamhana]] and [[Jabal Zayn al-Abidin]] mountain in Hama Governorate. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%87%d9%8a%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d9%83%d8%a8%d9%8a%d8%b1-%d9%84%d9%82%d9%88%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%86%d8%b8%d8%a7%d9%85-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%87%d9%80-%d9%80%d9%8a%d9%80-%d9%80%d8%a6%d8%a9/739376/ (SOHR)]
***[[2024 Homs offensive]]
****Syrian rebel forces capture and take military vehicles and ammunition from a Syrian military engineering battalion facility on the outskirts of the city of [[al-Rastan]] in [[Homs Governorate]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/%D9%82%D9%88%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%86%D8%B8%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D8%B2%D9%84-%D9%85%D8%AF%D9%8A%D9%86%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D9%85%D8%B5-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B1%D9%8A%D9%81-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B4/739407/ (SOHR)]
****A [[Russian Air Force|Russian]] jet launches an [[airstrike]] on the Rastan Bridge over the [[Orontes River]] in an attempt to impede the rebel advance on [[Al-Rastan]]. [https://syria.news-pravda.com/en/world/2024/12/05/2055.html (Pravda)] [https://www.syriahr.com/en/350698/ (SOHR)]
****Rebel forces take control of the town of [[Talbiseh]] in Homs Governorate as they advance south toward [[Homs]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%a8%d8%b9%d8%af-%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%87%d9%8a%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d9%82%d9%88%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%86%d8%b8%d8%a7%d9%85-%d9%81%d9%8a-%d9%85%d8%af%d9%8a%d9%86%d8%a9-%d8%ad%d9%85%d8%a7%d8%a9-%d8%a7/739364/ (SOHR)]
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Gaza genocide]]
****[[Amnesty International]] accuses [[Israel]] of committing [[genocide]] against [[Palestinians]] in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]]. Israel rejects the accusation, referring to Amnesty's statements as "fake news." [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/amnesty-report-says-israel-has-committed-genocide-against-palestinians-gaza-2024-12-05/ (Reuters)] [https://news.sky.com/story/israel-rejects-amnesty-genocide-claim-as-no-surprise-and-fake-news-13267655 (Sky News)]
***[[Kamal Adwan Hospital sieges]]
****An Israeli airstrike near the Kamal Adwan Hospital in [[northern Gaza]] kills a 16-year-old Palestinian boy  and injures at least 12 others. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/2581950/middle-east (Arab News)]
*[[Piracy off the coast of Somalia]]
**The [[European Union]]'s [[Operation Atalanta|anti-piracy mission]] says that heavily armed [[Somalia|Somali]] pirates have hijacked a [[China|Chinese]] fishing vessel off the coast of [[Puntland]], [[Somalia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/eu-naval-force-chinese-fishing-vessel-under-control-alleged-pirates-somali-2024-12-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[German economic crisis (2022–present)|German economic crisis]]
**[[Germany|German]] workers' union [[IG Metall]] announces they will go on extended [[labor strike|strikes]] next week leading up to a fourth round of [[collective bargaining|negotiations]] with [[Volkswagen]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/germany-vw-workers-announce-second-strike-as-cuts-loom/a-70978152 (DW)]
*The value of a [[Bitcoin]] surpasses US$100,000 for the first time, after increasing 130% in the past year. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/12/04/tech/bitcoin-100k-trump-hnk-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/business/markets/bitcoin-100000-rcna181008 (NBC News)]
*[[Great Britain|British]] multinational oil and gas company [[Shell plc|Shell]] and [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[State-owned enterprise|state-owned]] company [[Equinor]] announce a [[joint venture]] to [[Mergers and acquisitions|merge]] their [[North Sea oil|North Sea assets]]. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2024/12/06/shell-and-equinor-form-north-sea-oil-and-gas-joint-venture/ (''Cyprus Mail'')] [https://www.reuters.com/breakingviews/shell-equinor-make-best-uk-oil-decline-2024-12-05/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024 Cape Mendocino earthquake]]
**A 7.0 [[Richter scale|magnitude]] [[earthquake]] strikes offshore near the northern coast of [[California]], [[United States]]. [https://weather.com/news/news/2024-12-05-northern-california-earthquake-humboldt-county (Weather Channel)]
*[[Winter of 2024–25 in the Gaza Strip]]
**Heavy winter rainfall causes extensive flooding across [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], with a majority of tents in several refugee camps being destroyed. [https://www.rescue.org/press-release/irc-warns-devastation-after-gaza-floods (IRC)]
*Eight people are killed when a cargo [[truck]] loaded with [[fertilizer]]s hits pedestrians and crashes into a house in [[Makilala, Cotabato|Makilala]], [[Cotabato]], [[Philippines]]. [https://www.pna.gov.ph/articles/1239351 (Philippine News Agency)]

'''Health and environment'''
*The [[Mexico|Mexican]] [[Secretariat of Health|health department]] reports that thirteen children have died from a [[bloodstream infection]] caused by ''[[Klebsiella oxytoca]]'' found in contaminated [[intravenous therapy|IV bags]] in [[Mexico state]], [[Mexico]]. Seven children remain hospitalized. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/6/mexico-13-children-die-after-suspected-iv-bag-contamination (Al Jazeera)] 

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 French political crisis]]
**[[Michel Barnier]] resigns as [[Prime Minister of France]] following [[Collapse of the Barnier government|the collapse]] of the [[Barnier government]]. [https://news.sky.com/story/france-latest-french-pm-michel-barnier-faces-no-confidence-vote-as-government-on-brink-of-collapse-13266765 (Sky News)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[European Union Space Programme]]
**[[Copernicus Programme]]
***The [[European Space Agency]] (ESA) successfully launches the [[Vega C]] rocket carrying the [[Sentinel-1|Sentinel-1C]] satellite to monitor [[Earth]] from the [[Guiana Space Centre]] in [[Kourou]], [[French Guiana]], two years after its failed commercial flight. [https://www.dw.com/en/european-vega-c-rocket-launches-after-two-year-gap/a-70978600 (DW)] [https://www.esa.int/Space_in_Member_States/Spain/Doble_victoria_para_Europa_Sentinel-1C_y_Vega-C_surcan_los_cielos (European Space Agency)]
**[[ISRO]] successfully launches the [[Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle|PSLV-XL]] rocket carrying the European Space Agency's [[PROBA-3]] satellites from the [[Satish Dhawan Space Centre]] in [[Sriharikota]], [[Andhra Pradesh]], [[India]], in a [[solar observatory]] mission to gather data about the [[Sun]]'s [[atmosphere]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/india-with-esa-satellites-launches-artificial-eclipse-quest/a-70970788 (DW)] [https://www.elmundo.es/ciencia-y-salud/ciencia/2024/12/04/675027a5fc6c83fe268b4589-video.html (''El Mundo'')]
